title: Essential contacts
sub: The numbers a person calls when something is happening now. The digits are typed once; the label and the sentence saying when to use them are written and translated like any other editorial text.
empty: No essential contact yet. Create the first one so the home page stops relying on numbers written into the code.
rowAction.unpublishBody: Readers in {language} stop seeing this number. Everything written here stays, and you can publish the language again at any time.
create.title: Add an essential contact
create.hint: Write the label and the sentence saying when to use it, type the number, then save a draft, publish now, or schedule publication.
create.contentHint: The label names the line; the sentence beside it says when to call it. A language is only published once it has both.
create.numberHint: Typed once and never translated. Leave it empty for a tile that opens a page rather than a call.
create.ownerHint: Who is answerable for this number being right, and where it applies.
field.sourceLanguageHint: The language you write in first. Every other language is translated from it.
field.slugHint: Optional, and not a public URL: essential contacts are read inside the home page and have no page of their own. Generated from the label if empty.
field.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
field.whenToUseHint: One sentence: what this number answers, and when calling it is the right thing to do. This is the whole of what a reader has to go on, so it is required in every language that gets published.
field.iconHint: Drawn beside the label. Never the only cue — the label always says what the number is.
field.dialHint: Spacing is kept exactly as you type it, so the number stays copyable onto paper. A short code like 112 and an international number are both fine.
field.dialInvalid: Digits, spaces and the usual separators only.
field.reachHint: A number that is only texted must never be offered as a call.
field.dialInsteadHint: Optional. For a line that should only be called once another number has failed — the emergency number goes here, and the reader is told to try it first.
field.emergency: This is the number for danger
field.emergencyHint: One contact at most should carry this. It is drawn loudest, and a second one would make neither of them the loudest thing on the page.
field.operatorHint: State numbers are listed under “Urgent, now”. Association lines are listed below it, under a heading that tells readers a volunteer answers.
field.categoryHint: Optional. Lets the block sit this number beside the published activities that answer the same need.
field.answeredByHint: The association whose phone this is. Leave it empty for a number run by the state.
field.priorityHint: Lower comes first. On this block the order is itself advice — the emergency number above a volunteer line, never beside it — so you can reorder the whole block from the list afterwards.
field.organizationHint: Who answers for this number being right. Leave it as InfoKit when the platform checks it itself.
field.cityHint: Optional. Leave it empty for a number that applies everywhere.
freshness.heading: Checking it again
freshness.hint: A volunteer line moves when the association reorganises and nobody sends a notice, so every one of these carries a date it has to be checked again by.
field.reviewIntervalHint: Shorter for a line answered by volunteers, longer for a state number that does not move.
freshness.sourceSummaryHint: How you know the number is right — who confirmed it, and when. Read by your colleagues, never by the public.
freshness.confirm: I have just checked this number
freshness.confirmHint: Moves the check date to today and pushes the next one out by the interval. Nothing about the words changes.
publication.heading: Publication
publication.hint: Draft is the safe default. A colleague’s read is optional; the platform’s check is required before a number faces readers.
publication.team: Send to a colleague to read
publication.platform: Send to the platform to verify
publication.dateHint: The date is entered in your local time and displayed in Europe/Paris time.
language.optional: Optional — leave empty to omit this language.
order.heading: Order of the block
order.hint: The order readers meet these numbers in. Move the one for danger to the top.
translation.heading: Per-language publication
translation.publishBlocked: Write the label and the sentence in this language before publishing it.
action.saveContent: Save the words and the number
action.archiveConfirmBody: It comes off the public block in every language, and the number goes with it. It keeps its history and you can restore it later.
